acceptanceCriteria: Each of the three 0367 follow-ups (a graph that competes for positions by score, a smaller cap, a graph built with test-file edges) is either evaluated on the frozen retrieval evaluation with the slot on and off and its recall@20 deltas recorded per subset, or explicitly set aside with the reason.
The 0367 full-sample runs recorded NOT_RUN are run or the NOT_RUN is carried forward with a reason.
The graph stays off by default unless the V1-0083 closing rule (recall@20 improves on the RepoMap-deficit subsets, losing cases recorded) is met and recorded in BUILD-LOG.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 by decision 0373 item 13 (V1-0083 archived as not delivered; decision 0367 accepted as experimental, off by default). Decision 0367 records that the seeded graph ranks below the lexical tail it displaces (recall@20 regressed on every subset; recall@5 and recall@10 cannot move because the slot only fills the last five positions) and names three open follow-ups plus the NOT_RUN full-sample runs. The off-by-default cost stays on the default path: the graph section is built on every index and the schema bump rebuilds every snapshot.
title: context: identifier graph follow-ups from decision 0367 (score-competing graph, smaller cap, test-file edges, NOT_RUN full-sample rerun)
